comparison.objective: Diagnose and repair a keyed fixture by replacing, pinning, and functionally testing a guide; candidate adjusts an installed damper rather than replacing a faulty guide.
comparison.physical_skill: Both involve locking and functional verification, but the fixture task tests guide extraction, keyed insertion, pin latching, part orientation, and seating checks—not fine rotary calibration under impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Fixture success uses ≤1 mm seating and 11–13 mm blocking demonstrations in both orientations; candidate requires two dynamically acceptable cycles and a post-lock drift test.
comparison.reason: Shared maintenance structure does not erase the different tested abilities: component replacement and poka-yoke verification versus iterative dynamic tuning.
